text: A floating relic that remembers the lost tribes. Its telegraphed chime slows.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Gold Nuggets.
Mourning Bells float over the March Crystal Fields and Snow Fields, and now and then the Reed Fen and the Shallows.
It has **28 health** and **3 armour**. From up to 12 blocks away it rings a chime for **4 damage** that slows you for 3 seconds. Shelter interrupts the song.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Bell Fragment attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: Reach **Voice** with the **Seal-carvers**, then use a Bonding Charm on an adult: two tries in five, charm spent on failure.
A bonded bell clears poison, weakness and other hexes from you while it follows. See [familiar gifts](familiar_gifts).
pages.title: As a familiar
Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, it drops this when hunted, more with Looting.
